_contract: Base-model identity for the SD-1.5 backbone (M0). Every evaluation uses this backbone; an M0 evaluation is identified BY it, since M0 applies no delta. This replaces treating M0 as an accidental exception to checkpoint-hash binding.

identity_policy._note: The exact launch-time base-model identity policy and its limits. Written down because AUDIT-01c described --verify_base_model as 'the recomputed backbone identity', which reads as full backbone verification. It is not.
identity_policy.what_cheap_identity_covers: sha256 of each file in cheap_identity_payload.cheap_identity_files (five small JSON configs) and the BYTE LENGTH of each file in cheap_identity_payload.weight_file_bytes. The weight bytes themselves are never read.
identity_policy.what_cheap_identity_does_not_cover: the contents of unet/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors, and of every other weight file. A mutation of weight bytes that preserves the file length leaves cheap_identity_sha256 unchanged and passes --verify_base_model. This was reproduced on CPU by the independent review.
identity_policy.weight_sha256_is_recorded_but_not_checke: The full weight digest below is the complete content check. validate_stage.py compares it only under --verify_base_model_weight_sha, which reads ~3.4 GB. Neither run_seed.sh nor run_analysis.sh enables it, because evaluation validation runs once per checkpoint per path and re-hashing the backbone each time would add ~3.4 GB of reads per call for a backbone that is not written by this pipeline.
identity_policy.launch_time_policy: At launch, M0's identity is asserted STRUCTURALLY: no delta applied, no unet_ckpt, no recorded delta hash, and base_model_dir equal to this contract's. The cheap identity is DECLARED from this contract and is not recomputed unless --verify_base_model is passed. Non-M0 checkpoints are bound by the recomputed sha256 of their own delta.bin, which IS a full content check of the delta.
identity_policy.how_to_verify_the_backbone_in_full: python scripts/seq/validate_stage.py eval M0 --eval_root <dir> --manifest <manifest> --expect_manifest_sha <id> --expect_gen_settings configs/generation_settings.json --require_images --allow_shared_images --base_model_contract configs/base_model_contract.json --verify_base_model --verify_base_model_weight_sha
identity_policy.residual_limitation: Even the full weight digest is a check against THIS contract, whose values were derived from the on-disk backbone at AUDIT-01c. It establishes that the backbone has not changed since then; it does not establish that the backbone is the published Stable Diffusion v1.5 release. No upstream-published digest is compared here.

m0_policy.rationale: M0 is the untouched backbone: no delta is applied, so its identity is the base model, asserted via base_model_dir plus cheap_identity_sha256. A recorded delta hash must be ABSENT.
m0_policy.shared_evaluation: The M0 evaluation set is generated once and reused by every training seed via a symlink. Reuse must be declared with --allow_shared_images and M0 is counted ONCE in any generated-image total.
